mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major channel of visual communication in Africa."
Physical Appearance - Physical appearance is a major channel of visual communication in Africa.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important mode of communication in Africa."
Poetry is an important mode of communication in Africa.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an alphabet or code in which letters are represented by a combination of long and short light or sounds and signals."
Morse code is an alphabet or code in which letters are represented by a combination of long and short light or sounds and signals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic form of African communication."
Music is a basic form of African communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to wear a lot of gold necklaces, ear rings, wrist watches and bangles."
Northern women are known to wear a lot of gold necklaces, ear rings, wrist watches and bangles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in divination to determine the will of deities."
Cowries and kolanuts are used in divination to determine the will of deities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important mode of communication in Africa because it can perform all the functions of communication at the same time."
Song is an important mode of communication in Africa because it can perform all the functions of communication at the same time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the appearance that one sees that enables categorization or classification of colours."
Hue is the appearance that one sees that enables categorization or classification of colours.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrumental appliances built or mounted on half of gourd keg of the size of a medium football."
Ekele or Akpata is an instrumental appliances built or mounted on half of gourd keg of the size of a medium football.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vast continent that is made up of diverse peoples."
Africa is a vast continent that is made up of diverse peoples.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process by which a sender passes information to the decoder or receiver."
Communication is a process by which a sender passes information to the decoder or receiver.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Yoruba accessory and any man wearing it, is more often than not a Yoruba man."
The Abeti-aja (dog ear-shaped cap) is a Yoruba accessory and any man wearing it, is more often than not a Yoruba man.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the drum of 'Obatala, or 'Orisa-Nla' the arch-divinity."
Igbin is the drum of 'Obatala, or 'Orisa-Nla' the arch-divinity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all signs and gestures made with any part of the human body for the purpose of communication (Ibagere, 1994)."
Body language refers to all signs and gestures made with any part of the human body for the purpose of communication (Ibagere, 1994).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for praising the Almighty God."
Praise songs are used for praising the Almighty God.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a trumpet made of elephant tusk."
Ekpili or Eze-Anu is a trumpet made of elephant tusk.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the instrument used in summoning the Council of Elders' meeting - the council of the community."
Odu is the instrument used in summoning the Council of Elders' meeting - the council of the community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of arbitrary symbols, matched with meaning and used by a group of people for communication."
Language is a set of arbitrary symbols, matched with meaning and used by a group of people for communication.
